name: Keyed gear
brief: Build a Spur Gear mounted on stepped Shaft and locked with a key

reply.summary: A stepped shaft carrying a spur gear locked with a parallel key and seated against the shoulder.
assumptions: No bearings, housing or retaining ring added, since the brief asks only for the gear, shaft and key.
The gear seats against the shaft shoulder because the shaft is stepped.
Sizes are left out; the key is sized from the shaft diameter by DIN 6885.
